description: Extracts the single most-likely causal fix site from a detective investigation that ended in prose.
body:
A code investigation of a bug produced the analysis below. Extract the single most-likely causal fix site and output ONLY a JSON array — no prose, no markdown fences, then stop. If the analysis is incomplete, output your BEST hypothesis from what it contains (a best guess beats nothing).
[{"file":"<repo-relative path>","function":"<symbol>","reason":"<why THIS computes the wrong value, not just displays it>","fix":"<the exact minimal change: which line/expression to change and which EXISTING helper (symbol) to reuse>","helper":"<bare existing symbol name to reuse, or empty>"}]

=== INVESTIGATION ===
